description: This file defines the KeyValueEntityStorage class, which provides a storage backend for entities using a key-value store in Drupal. It includes methods for creating, loading, saving, deleting, and querying entities, and manages dependencies like UUIDs and language settings.

classes.name: KeyValueEntityStorage
classes.description: A storage class for entities backed by a key-value store, supporting creation, loading, saving, deletion, and querying of entities within Drupal.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of KeyValueEntityStorage using dependency injection container and entity type.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Creates a new entity object with default values and language settings.

methods.name: doLoadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple entities by their IDs or all if no IDs are provided.

methods.name: mapFromStorageRecords
methods.description: Maps raw storage records to entity objects.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes entities from the key-value store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an entity to the key-value store, checking ID validity and length.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, handling new and updated entities, and deletes old records if renamed.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if an entity exists in the store by ID.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if the store contains any data.

methods.name: getQueryServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name used for querying entities.
